shellCommands.command: ls -la && git status --short && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/ -R | head -100

cat AGENTS.md; echo ---; cat index.html; echo ---; ls -R src; echo ---; cat src/*.tsx src/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150; echo ---; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; echo ---; ls node_modules | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; ls __agent_eval__ .claude

npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version 2>&1 | tail -2 && npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -20 && node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" && node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').peerDependencies)"

node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').peerDependenciesMeta)"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60

sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && cat components/controls/TextInput.md | head -150; echo =====PASSWORD; cat components/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -80; echo =====CHECKBOX; cat components/Checkbox.md | head -120
head -120 components/Button.md; echo =====TEXT; sed -n 1,80p components/Text.md; echo =====THEME; rg -n -C 3 "ThemeProvider|Provider|theme=\"system\"|scoped" guides/theming.md | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; rg -n -i "required setup|Provider" $U/README.md | head -20; echo ====; rg -n -C 2 "^## |Required|styles.css" $U/README.md | head -60; echo ====TYPO; rg -n "header-1|subheader-1|body-2" $U/build/docs/guides/typography.md | head -10; echo ====FLEX; rg -n -C 2 "Flex" $U/build/docs/guides/layout.md | head -60; echo ====EXPORTS; node -e "const m=require('./$U/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(m.exports['.']||m.main))"; rg -n "export .*\bProvider\b|ThemeProvider" $U/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls $U/build | head -30

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Provider TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Button Text Flex Box Card 2>&1 | head -60; echo ===; rg -n "interface PasswordInputProps|interface TextInputProps|interface CheckboxProps|export declare const Provider\b|declare const Provider:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -20

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Provider TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Button Text Flex 2>&1 | head -60; echo ===; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ===; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && rg -n "export declare const Provider|export \{.*Provider" index.d.ts components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n "export declare const Provider" -g '*.d.ts' . | head -3; rg -n "width|loading|view\?|size\?" components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -12; rg -n "gap|direction|alignItems" components/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8; rg -n "export type Checkbox|onUpdate" components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -4; ls components/Flex components/Button 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; E=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; rg -n "Provider" $E/index.d.ts | head -5; rg -ln "export declare const Provider\b|const Provider:" $E --glob '*.d.ts' | head -3; echo ===BUTTON; sed -n 1,60p $E/components/Button/Button.d.ts; echo ===CHECKBOX; sed -n 1,30p $E/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; echo ===FLEX; ls $E/components | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; E=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $E/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; rg -n "theme/|ThemeProvider|Provider" $E/index.d.ts $E/components/index.d.ts $E/theme/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -12; echo ===; rg -n "export .*Provider" $E --glob '*.d.ts' -l | head -10; echo ===ButtonTypes; rg -n "width|loading|view" $E/components/Button/types.d.ts | head -12; echo ===Layout; ls $E/layout; rg -n "export" $E/layout/index.d.ts | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; E=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $E/components/theme/Provider.d.ts | head -30; echo ===; cat $E/components/theme/index.d.ts; echo ===; rg -n "ButtonWidth|ButtonView =" $E/components/Button/types.d.ts | head -4; echo ===FLEX; rg -ln "export declare const Flex\b" $E --glob '*.d.ts'; cat $E/components/Button/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,20p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; E=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; sed -n 1,40p $E/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts; rg -n "'action'|\"action\"" $E/components/Button/constants.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "gap" $E/components/layout/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls $E/components/layout; ls $E/styles 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; cat src/index.css; echo ===; cat src/vite-env.d.ts; echo ===; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Card.md; echo ===; rg -n "size\?|view\?|spacing|width" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; E=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; rg -n "type SpacingValue" $E -g '*.d.ts' | head -3; rg -n "CardSize\b" $E/components/Card/*.d.ts | head -3; rg -o "\-\-g-spacing-[0-9a-z-]+" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -20
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

rm -rf dist && git diff --stat; git status --short; echo ===; cat package.json | sed -n 10,20p; echo ===; rg -n "padding" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.css | head -10; rg -n "padding" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/*.css | head; echo ===; npm audit --omit=dev 2>/dev/null | tail -3

rg -n "padding|spacing|--g-card" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.js | head -10; rg -n "\-\-g-card-(padding|border)" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes -l | head -2; rg -o "\-\-g-card[a-z-]*" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head; rg -n "^\.g-card|\.g-card" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.css | head -5

sed -n 1,12p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.css; rg -n "g-card_size|size" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.css | head -5; rg -n "\.g-card_size_l|\.g-card_size_m" -A4 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.css | head -12
sed -n 127,140p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.css
